findings.evidence: return [value for value in left if value in right]
findings.summary: Linear membership lookup in list causes O(len(left) * len(right)) overall time complexity.
findings.suggested_action: Convert right to a set first (e.g. `right_set = set(right)`) and test membership against the set to achieve O(len(left) + len(right)) average time complexity.

limitations: No runtime benchmarks or execution profilers were run to evaluate actual input sizes or memory overhead of set creation.

findings.summary: Function signature is missing PEP 484 type annotations for parameters and return value.
findings.suggested_action: Add type annotations to parameter list and return value, for example: def overlap(left: list[int], right: list[int]) -> list[int]:

limitations: No project-specific style guide, linter configurations (e.g., flake8, black, ruff), or type checker configurations (e.g., mypy) were provided.
